name: Recheck Every Window
summary: Slide a fixed window of length len(p) across s and, for each position, rebuild its letter counts from scratch and compare them to p's counts.
visualizationIntent: init: build p's letter-count target and show s as a row of characters. loop: place a window of width len(p) at each start; the pos cursor scans the window rebuilding its counts. check: compare the window's counts to p's; on a match flash the whole window green and record start. return: the list of matching start indices.

lineExplanations.3: Create the list of window start indices that are anagrams of p.
lineExplanations.5: Length of the pattern p; also the window width.
lineExplanations.8: Tally that character into p's target counts.
lineExplanations.9: Start the first window at index 0.
lineExplanations.10: Keep going while a full-width window still fits inside s.
lineExplanations.12: Reset a fresh 26-slot count for this window.
lineExplanations.13: Assume this window is not a match until proven.
lineExplanations.14: Place the scan cursor at the window's first character.
lineExplanations.15: Scan every character inside the window.
lineExplanations.16: Tally the current character into the window's counts.
lineExplanations.18: Compare the window's counts to p's target.
lineExplanations.19: Mark this window as a matching anagram.
lineExplanations.21: Slide the window one step to the right.

syntaxExplanations.1: class Solution: defines the class wrapper expected by the platform.
syntaxExplanations.2: def findAnagrams(self, s, p): receives the text s and pattern p.
syntaxExplanations.3: result = [] creates the empty answer list.
syntaxExplanations.4: n = len(s) stores the text length.
syntaxExplanations.5: m = len(p) stores the pattern length (window width).
syntaxExplanations.6: need = [0] * 26 makes a count slot for each lowercase letter.
syntaxExplanations.7: for ch in p: iterates the pattern's characters.
syntaxExplanations.9: start = 0 places the first window at the left.
syntaxExplanations.10: while start + m <= n: runs while a full window fits.
syntaxExplanations.11: end = start + m - 1 is the window's last index.
syntaxExplanations.12: window = [0] * 26 resets the window's letter counts.
syntaxExplanations.13: matched = False assumes no match yet.
syntaxExplanations.14: pos = start sets the scan cursor to the window start.
syntaxExplanations.15: while pos <= end: scans to the window end.
syntaxExplanations.18: if window == need: is true when the counts match exactly.
syntaxExplanations.19: matched = True flags a successful window.
syntaxExplanations.20: result.append(start) records the matching start index.
syntaxExplanations.21: start += 1 slides the window right by one.
syntaxExplanations.22: return result hands back all matching starts.
